# Genome Evolution Design System

> Genome Evolution is the design system for Bizagi / Genome Plus. This repository provides component documentation, design foundations, design tokens, composition patterns, AI usage guidance, and a React implementation to support consistent interface generation.

Use Figma as the source of truth for intended visual design. Use repository documentation and implementation resources to understand component usage, design-system conventions, available tokens, and technical constraints. See [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the complete source-of-truth and workflow rules.

## Start Here

- [Agent Instructions](AGENTS.md): Workflow, source-of-truth rules, and verification guidance for AI agents.
- [README](README.md): General overview and repository structure.
- [Component Manifest](manifest.json): Structured component inventory, metadata, variants, and documentation paths.

## Component Documentation

- [Component Catalog](components/): Component purpose, anatomy, properties, variants, states, and usage guidance.
- [Spanish Component Documentation](components/es/): Spanish versions of component documentation.

## Design Foundations

- [Foundations](foundations/): Color, typography, spacing, borders, opacity, elevation, and layout.

## Design Tokens

- [Token Package](packages/tokens/): Design token source and package resources.
- [Token Usage Rules](ai/token-usage-rules.md): Guidance for applying design tokens consistently.

## Composition Patterns

- [Patterns](patterns/): Documented patterns for combining components.

## AI Guidance

- [AI Directory](ai/): AI usage rules, including token usage rules and the evaluation checklist.
- [Evaluation Checklist](ai/evaluation-checklist.md): Criteria for reviewing interface quality and design-system consistency.

## Documentation Templates

- [Documentation Templates](templates/): Templates for creating and organizing component documentation. Assess their suitability before reuse; they are not guaranteed to be fully verified or current.

## React Implementation

- [React Package](packages/react/): Implementation resources for understanding available components, properties, and technical constraints. Verify exports in `packages/react/src/index.ts` before using them.

This file is an entry point to repository resources. It does not replace `AGENTS.md` or the detailed sources it references.
